articles.title: Provider Technical Obligations
articles.summary: The Provider maintains SRE in good faith while preserving legal and security boundaries.

articles.title: Satisfactory Cooperation
articles.summary: Voluntary cooperation sessions of at least 30 minutes qualify; 30 to 120 minutes is the normal range.

articles.title: World Preservation
articles.summary: Shared worlds and saves are backed up and treated with care.

articles.title: Avoidable Repair and Token Cost
articles.summary: Avoidable damage may be recorded for humorous, cooperative remediation.

articles.title: No Rage Quitting
articles.summary: Parties communicate before abandoning a scheduled cooperative activity.

articles.title: Good-Faith Participation
articles.summary: Participation is collaborative and honest, not mechanically optimized around loopholes.

articles.title: Major Infrastructure Change Control
articles.summary: Material shared-world changes require notice and agreement.

articles.title: Save Integrity
articles.summary: SRE never deletes, encrypts, or silently modifies user saves.

articles.title: Remediation
articles.summary: Breaches use proportionate, documented, non-destructive remediation.

articles.title: Scheduling
articles.summary: Schedules respect availability, consent, time zones, work, sleep, and real life.

articles.title: Hydration Recommendation
articles.summary: Long sessions may show a dismissible hydration reminder.

articles.title: Anti-Loophole and Good Faith
articles.summary: Technical compliance does not override the cooperative purpose of the Accord.

articles.title: Entitlement Remedies
articles.summary: Suspension only prevents a future FTEP-authorized launch; it never damages files or systems.

articles.title: Restoration of Privileges
articles.summary: Completed remediation restores future launch eligibility and is recorded transparently.

articles.title: Scope Expansion
articles.summary: New title requests enter review and do not automatically create contractual debt.

articles.title: Reciprocal Performance
articles.summary: Each party's obligations remain proportionate and mutually understood.

articles.title: Anti-Crunch and Human Limits
articles.summary: No sleep deprivation, continuous play, coercive crunch, or health-compromising behavior is recognized or required.
